summary: Practical Dubai property buying framework from his own investments (7 points): yields - his Business Bay 2-bed (bought 2020 at 1.4M AED) nets ~6% in AED / ~9% in INR terms, tax-free as UAE tax resident; expect some correction as the market softens into a buyer's market; buy in the budget segment at the right PSF (his: ~1,600 AED/psf vs 3,000 off-plan across the road); Dubai's market has matured so corrections should be gradual, not 2008-style; demand is interest-rate driven and rates are moderating; best deals come from distressed end users (handover fire sales), not developers; no 'best area' - correct PSF within a proven cluster matters, and match unit type to the end user. Who buys: long-term residents and tax-residency/golden-visa seekers; speculators and the over-leveraged should avoid. Calls: none - real estate only.
title: Everything I Wish I Knew Before Buying a property in Dubai | Akshat Shrivastava
